title: What If You Never Took A Bath? The 7-Day Cartoon Experiment!
primary_keyword: what if you never bathed kids science cartoon
fact_summary: Your skin sheds billions of microscopic cells and sweats every day; without soap and warm water, harmless micro-bugs multiply into itchy, stinky grease armies!
hook: On Day 1, you smell like peanut butter! But on Day 7, tiny tickly germ monsters start throwing a wild dance party on your elbows! What really happens?

lines.text: What if you decided to NEVER take a bath again?
lines.caps: What if you decided to *NEVER | take a bath *AGAIN?!

lines.text: On Day One, you just smell a tiny bit like peanut butter!
lines.caps: On Day One, you just smell | a tiny bit like *PEANUT *BUTTER!

lines.text: By Day Three, sticky sweat traps dust from your soccer shoes!
lines.caps: By Day Three, *STICKY sweat traps | dust from your *SOCCER *SHOES!

lines.text: Your head begins to itch like ten playful fleas are jumping around!
lines.caps: Your head begins to *ITCH | like ten playful *FLEAS | are jumping *AROUND!

lines.text: On Day Seven, microscopic germ monsters throw a wild party on your elbows!
lines.caps: On Day Seven, microscopic *GERM | monsters throw a wild *PARTY | on your *ELBOWS!

lines.text: They munch on dead skin cells and build smelly stink forts!
lines.caps: They munch on *DEAD skin cells | and build smelly *STINK *FORTS!

lines.text: Soap is your superhero shield! It washes away bad germs in seconds!
lines.caps: *SOAP is your superhero *SHIELD! | It washes away bad *GERMS | in *SECONDS!

lines.text: Warm bubbly water makes you fresh, clean, and ready to conquer the world!
lines.caps: Warm bubbly water makes you *FRESH, | clean, and ready to *CONQUER | the *WORLD!
